name: Wood Contracting Chicago

gbp_reviews_visible.text: We hired Wood Contracting to completely renovate our kids' bathroom. The room is very small and our goal was to create a space that was beautiful and functional. …

Highly recommend them! They recently replaced my bathroom tile, and the experience was fantastic. They were extremely transparent about costs and timeline. Our project had a moving timeline, and they were flexible and accommodating with the adjustments. Thanks Sarah and Dillon!

We recently hired Wood Contracting to remodel two of our bathrooms, a full bath in hall and a master bath, both completely overhauled, and we couldn't be happier with the results! From start to finish, the team was professional, transparent …

decision_maker.name: Dillon Wood
decision_maker.quote: Owner Dillon Wood personally oversees every residential remodeling project, ensuring quality control and direct communication
decision_maker.note: /about also lists 'Dillon Wood Owner & General Contractor'.

assessment: Opinion: a strong owner-run Chicago kitchen and bath remodeller with an active Webflow blog, live hiring and published high-ticket pricing; a good prospect with a named owner and a direct info@ address.
